    """Shear each row left by its distance above the bottommost object row."""
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    colored = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value]
    if not colored:

    out = [[0] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    for r, c in colored:
        nc = c + r - bottom
        if 0 <= nc < cols:
            out[r][nc] = grid[r][c]
    return out
